logp.method_description: Aqueous solutions of HPRCs (5 mL, 10 μM) were mixed well with n-octanol (5 mL) in a 15 mlcentrifuge tube. The tube was wrapped in aluminum foil, shaken for 24 h in a thermostatic shakerincubator, and allowed to settle until the two phases were completely separated. Since theconcentration of the complex in the aqueous phase was rather low, the absorbance was determinedusing a 1-mm optical path cuvette after 10 times of concentration by vacuum evaporation. The octanolphase is diluted by 10 or 100 times, and absorbance was measure using the same cuvette. The oil andwater distribution coefficients (log KO/W) were calculated using the relative concentrations of HPRCsin the two phases which obtained from job plot of absorbance vs. concentrations in each phase.8 Theerrors are estimated as less than 5%.
